queries.clock: SELECT event_time_utc FROM routelens_p05.namespace_clock WHERE namespace=$1
queries.traversals: SELECT count(*)::int AS count FROM routelens_p05.traversals WHERE namespace=$1
queries.publications: SELECT sequence,traffic_snapshot_id,octet_length(artifact) AS artifact_bytes FROM routelens_p07.publications WHERE namespace=$1 ORDER BY sequence
queries.consumers: SELECT consumer_id,high_water,last_snapshot_id,octet_length(artifact) AS artifact_bytes FROM routelens_p07.consumer_states WHERE namespace=$1 ORDER BY consumer_id
